regions.merged_text: God bless you Miss Krausman. Many thanks for your favor of some weeks past - I wanted to write you for Christmas but that be- came just impossible. I am glad to learn that notwithstanding the many difficulties your dear ones meet with, still in general things seem to improve anyhow.

regions.merged_text: So God bless you - Dad and little Mary Jane and all - to all a Blessed New Year.
